releaseNotes:
• App version 2.1.0 release
• Native Android 5-tab navigation bar (Home, Notes, Chat, Calls, Settings) with Raspberry & Pale Sky styling
• Shared-element animated transitions between screens and partner card into Chat
• In-app top back navigation buttons and Android system back handling across all secondary screens
• Complete real-time Audio and Video calling controls with camera switch, PiP mode, and speakerphone routing
• Full couple notes management, message state receipts, and private pairing setup
